versions.changelog:
Initial release — provides end-to-end technical support and guidance for building and deploying interactive digital humans.

- Covers the full process from data collection to model training.
- Supports voice cloning (using GPT-SoVITS or Fish Speech) and lip-sync (SadTalker, Live2D, Wav2Lip).
- Enables logical integration with LLMs (OpenClaw) for real-time interaction.
- Recommends optimized deployment methods (local GPU or cloud API) for response times under 500ms.
- Includes practical selection advice and example workflows for building live digital characters.
